items.title: Videogame Stocks Fall After Meta Announces AI Game Tool. Don’t Be Spooked Yet.
items.summary: Videogame stocks took a hit Thursday afternoon after  Meta Platforms  announced new artificial intelligence tools that can build mobile games.  Gaming investors shouldn’t be concerned just yet.  Meta  announced during the second day of its Connect conference that it was launching two new tools—Horizon Create and Horizon Studio—that enable creators to turn ideas into complete 2-D and 3-D mobile games.

items.title: GameStop Jumps 4% as Ryan Cohen Buys 1.15 Million More Shares
items.summary: Ryan Cohen just bought another million-plus shares of GameStop at a higher price than his purchase two weeks ago, yet the stock is barely moving. That gap between what the CEO is signaling and how the market is responding tells a complicated story about where GameStop goes from here.
